status: findings for implementer; new runtime evidence must be sealed before report acceptance

findings.message: Reject a running repair attempt even when the previous attempt had passed review.
findings.trigger: Run all feature checks after an accepted T1/A1; prepare/start T1/A2. startTask preserves A1 reviewStatus=passed while setting status=running and attemptId=A2. evaluateGate('final', {includeManual:false}) then returns ok=true before A2 is DONE or reviewed.
findings.impact: The FINAL_REVIEW admission gate can open while the repair worker is active. The old attempt's review is treated as current task completion.

findings.message: Route unresolved repair tasks and their independent reviews before feature acceptance in late stages.
findings.trigger: Complete a repair attempt in VERIFYING with all its checks passed. The ledger correctly becomes review_pending, but nextAction returns verify with a transition-to-FINAL_REVIEW reason. With the same task state in FINAL_REVIEW, it returns dispatch_reviewer for gate=final and taskId=null.
findings.impact: The coordinator never dispatches the required task re-review in these states and can advance toward final review while the task has unresolved review work; this is the loop prohibited by proposal section 7.2.

findings.message: Preserve the repair budget when replacing the current task result.
findings.trigger: A task with fixRound=2 starts A2, runs both required checks and submits DONE. acceptTaskResult replaces taskResults[T1] without fixRound; the recorded value becomes undefined.
findings.impact: Subsequent acceptReview defaults the missing counter to zero, so the configured maxFixRounds can be bypassed through normal repair attempts.

findings.message: Persist and apply the repair budget for test-triggered repairs, separately from reviewer findings.
findings.trigger: A feature check fails and is repeatedly repaired/rerun without an intervening independent review. runVerification only persists verification records and refreshes results; no failure repair count is incremented or maxFixRounds consulted. VERIFYING nextAction continues to return verify indefinitely.
findings.impact: The exact test-driven failure path introduced by this change has no persistent bounded repair loop, contrary to proposal section 7.2; existing review-only counters do not cover it.

findings.message: Render the spec acceptance view without requiring the later plan's cases, checks and environments.
findings.trigger: A v2 delivery with confirmed ACs and verification=test passes validateDelivery(...,{phase:'spec'}), while tasks/testCases/checks/environments are intentionally still unset. renderDelivery revalidates with hard-coded phase='plan' and throws INVALID_DELIVERY, including MISSING_CASES and MISSING_VERIFICATION_INPUTS. renderFeatureArtifacts({phase:'spec'}) also calls this hard-coded path.
findings.impact: A valid spec-stage definition cannot generate the required acceptance.md until plan-stage details are prematurely filled, defeating the explicit stage-specific completeness rule.

limitations: P5 real-business repository pilot excluded as instructed.
No production access, dependency installation or real human approvals.
Reproducers use isolated temporary protocol fixtures; they do not claim browser semantic validation.
No formal final report accepted yet; findings require implementation correction and fresh sealed packet review.
